system.description: When you make an attack with metallic ammunition—including bullets, thrown knives, metallic bolts, or metal-tipped arrows—on a target within short range, you can improve the attack's aim and velocity, which grants an asset to the attack and inflicts an additional 3 damage. You can use this ability only once per round. Effort: Affect an ally's attack instead of your own if their attack passes within short range. Enabler.
